premises.text: No single platform previously offered all telecom services (carrier, PBX, developer APIs) in one switch system
premises.evidence_span: there hasn't been a single platform where you can actually get all of your telecommunication services from the same system until today

premises.text: Mobile is integrated directly into the switch over the cellular network so business logic and routing apply to cell calls (not just OTT apps)
premises.evidence_span: utilizing the Sprint network, we have been able to integrate mobile with our switch directly

premises.text: BYOD activation and core-network features (seamless transfer, presence, non-GPS location, extension dialing, cloud call recording) work because the phone is tied into the switch
premises.evidence_span: you can actually bring your own device

premises.text: Advanced switch capabilities include real-time speech-to-text transcription, private telecom networks, and cheaper international IP calling
premises.evidence_span: you can do advanced features like real-time transcription

premises.text: Cellular activation and services are exposed via APIs so customers can attach their own software or non-phone devices
premises.evidence_span: all of this technology, even the activation of the cell phone, is being done via APIs that are exposed to you

domains.name: unified communications switch with cellular mobile

value.text: True business-phone capability on mobile with carrier-quality voice and switch-controlled features

causal_links.evidence_span: This is an actual tie-in to the cellular network where your mobile call is going over actual phone channel
international calls or IP are significantly cheaper
you can attach your own software and your own systems to activate the cellular devices

notes: BYOD demo feature cascade (transfer, presence, location, recording) folded into P3 as consequences of core-network mobile integration (v1.5.1 §4.1.7 / School Bridge feature cascade). Transcription/private nets/cheap IP kept as one advanced-features package of the same switch unless treated as separately sold—speaker presents them as advanced features of the same system; residual doubt noted but kept one package. Voice-channel quality contrast folded into value of P2.
